overlapPolicies.segmentRule: same segment_date AND (candidate.day_portion = full OR peer.day_portion = full OR candidate.day_portion = peer.day_portion)
enforcementSurface: @afenda/human-resources memory adapter: withLeaveEmployeeBookingLock + adapter re-check on submit/approve
@afenda/human-resources drizzle adapter: Serializable txn + pg_advisory_xact_lock(org:employee) + buildLeaveOverlapGuardCtes on submit/approve
overlapPolicies.notes: Half-day semantics (morning/afternoon/full) prevent a naive btree_gist EXCLUDE on date ranges alone; overlap is fail-closed at command and Serializable transaction layers. No PostgreSQL exclusion constraint or constraint trigger in this closure.
